name: Cursor Security Review
desc: Always-on agents that check every change for security problems.
desc_zh: 常驻检查每次改动安全问题的智能体。
solves: Security review happens late, if at all, on agent-heavy repositories; two agent types watch each change for vulnerabilities and regressions.
solves_zh: 智能体重度参与的仓库里，安全审查要么很晚要么没有；两类智能体会盯着每次改动找漏洞和回归。
best_for: Your repository takes outside contributions and nobody on the team is a security reviewer.
best_for_zh: 仓库接受外部贡献，而团队里没有人专职做安全审查。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cursor.com/changelog directory）。 Beta on Teams and Enterprise at launch. 首次公开日期来源：https://cursor.com/changelog/04-30-26
